description: Realistic synthetic set, modelled on the owner's live sheet rows: abbreviated names and brand cells, no barcode, size, category or Arabic name, and mostly non-dairy categories (fries, tuna, spices, luncheon meat, household, tissues, flowers, generic rows). Each SKU lists the live failure patterns it carries (patterns): brand_page_wrong_pack (a listing that names the brand while its picture is another brand's pack), size_not_on_front, near_duplicate (one picture on several domains: seed_of reuses another candidate's seed), non_white_backdrop (recipe packshot_backdrop, tests/eval/imagegen_extra.py), generic and out_of_scope rows, social, multipack, foreign_store, abbreviated. Labels describe the listing and the picture, never an engine result. Replay: python scripts/eval_report.py --engine v2 --set realistic.
